data.rationale: The proposal follows the same EDGAR, then Wikipedia, then email sequence with nearly the same parameters (recipient_email stands in for {manager}@example.com). It misses the Mail tab and the "do not send, click Discard" ending, saying "send (or save the draft)" instead, which would send a real email. It is also vague about how the recipient address is built and about the tab switching, so an automation could be built but would be partly unsafe or ambiguous.
